summary.title: AI Summary

summary.analyze_first_help: Analyze a document before generating an AI summary.

content_review.notice: This check helps find issues in the text and make it easier to understand.
content_review.legacy_help: The recommended mode sends only a verified protected copy; legacy mode does not see the document pages.
content_review.analyze_first_help: Analyze a document before reviewing its content.
content_review.start: Choose a review depth and start the content quality review.
layout_review.title: Visual Layout Review
layout_review.notice: This check helps assess how neat and easy to read the document looks.
layout_review.protected_action: Prepare a protected copy for AI
layout_review.original_action: Send original page images (legacy, paid tier)

layout_review.select_pdf: Select a PDF document to review its visual layout.

layout_review.pdf_only: Visual layout review is available only for PDF documents.

tools.title: Document tools
tools.subtitle: Compress, convert and protect files
tools.redaction.title: Protect data
tools.redaction.description: Find and permanently remove confidential information.
tools.redaction.help: Choose categories, then review and disable individual findings before applying.
tools.redaction.personal_help: Names, IDs, phone, email and address.
tools.redaction.visual_help: Faces, signatures and colored stamps; manual review required.
tools.redaction.service_help: Organizations, business IDs and document numbers; opt-in.
tools.redaction.context_help: Dates and times; this aggressive opt-in mode may hide meaningful content.
tools.redaction.source_locked: The source document and redaction job are locked until verification finishes.
tools.redaction.protected_processing: The protected copy is being created and verified. Progress is also preserved in the job history.
tools.redaction.editor_help: Drag on the page to add an area. Drag a corner to resize it.
tools.protected_ai.cleanup_status.retain: the provider is retaining the copy
tools.protected_ai.confirm.cancel_analys: Cancel the AI analysis? Work already completed will be lost.
tools.protected_ai.confirm.delete_artifa: Delete the protected copy? This action cannot be undone.
tools.protected_ai.notice.verifying: Checking PDF integrity, page coverage and residual confidential data.
tools.protected_ai.notice.needs_review: AI upload is blocked because verification found a risk. Review the protected copy and create it again after correcting the issue.
tools.protected_ai.notice.failed: The protected copy could not be verified.
tools.protected_ai.preview.title: Final protected PDF copy
tools.protected_ai.preview.unavailable: This page could not be displayed. You can still download the PDF.
tools.protected_ai.verification.flattene: Safe image-only copy: text selection is disabled, and verification and AI use OCR.
tools.protected_ai.actions.remote_delete: First delete every retained copy from the AI provider in the results below.
tools.protected_ai.actions.delete_remote: Delete the AI provider copy now
tools.protected_ai.consent.title: Confirm AI analysis
tools.protected_ai.consent.notice: Only the verified protected PDF copy, not the original file, will be sent to the external AI service. Automatic masking reduces risk but cannot guarantee that every piece of sensitive data has been removed.
tools.protected_ai.consent.verified_only: The provider accepts only an artifact with the Ready for AI status.
tools.protected_ai.consent.unpaid_warnin: The unpaid tier is not intended for original personal or confidential data. Review the protected PDF again before sending it.
tools.protected_ai.consent.retention_leg: File retention by the AI provider
tools.protected_ai.consent.retain_48h_he: Useful for running another analysis without uploading again.
tools.protected_ai.consent.processing: I authorize sending the protected copy to the external AI provider for the selected analysis.
tools.protected_ai.consent.terms: I understand the AI provider's data processing and retention terms.
tools.compression.title: Compress PDF
tools.compression.description: Reduce file size with a chosen quality balance.
tools.compression.low_help: Removes overhead and repacks the file without resizing images.
tools.compression.recommended_help: Preserves text and vectors while moderately reducing images.
tools.compression.extreme_help: Reduces images more aggressively; fine details may be less sharp.
tools.compression.estimate_note: Ranges are estimates; actual savings depend on the source PDF.
tools.conversion.title: Convert a file
tools.conversion.description: Create a PDF from Word or an editable Word file from PDF.
tools.conversion.word_help: DOCX, DOC and ODT are converted locally while preserving available formatting.
tools.conversion.pdf_help: Creates an editable DOCX; complex layout may change.
tools.conversion.ocr_help: Text recognition starts automatically for scanned pages.
